# opalstack_osuser (Resource)

A shell user. Apps belong to one and run as it. Nothing about a shell user can be changed in place, and deleting one deletes its home directory.

The API chooses the password and reports it once, in `default_password`. This resource does not set a password of your own, and the API has no way to manage SSH keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_server" "web" {
  hostname = "opal1.opalstack.com"
}

resource "opalstack_osuser" "deploy" {
  name      = "deploy"
  server_id = data.opalstack_server.web.id
}

# The API chooses the password and reports it once.
output "deploy_password" {
  value     = opalstack_osuser.deploy.default_password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Login name. Changing it replaces the shell user.
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the shell user lives on. Changing it replaces the shell user.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `default_password` (String, Sensitive) The password the API chose when it created the shell user. The API reports it only then, so it is null for a shell user that was imported.
- `id` (String) UUID of the shell user.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opalstack_osuser.deploy deploy
# or by UUID
terraform import opalstack_osuser.deploy 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
